anthropicAutoCacheControl.label: Anthropic Stable Prefix Cache
anthropicAutoCacheControl.hint: Automatically add cache_control to long system prompts, tools, or the first long user context

openAIAutoPromptCacheKey.label: OpenAI Stable Cache Key
openAIAutoPromptCacheKey.hint: When the client omits prompt_cache_key, generate an opaque stable key from the user, request model, system/tool anchors, and first user message. Client values always win.

headerDefaults.title: Header Defaults
headerDefaults.hint: Filled only when the upstream request is missing these client identity headers. Channel custom headers still override them.
headerDefaults.description: Claude applies to Anthropic channels. Codex applies to OpenAI Responses channels.
headerDefaults.claudeDescription: Manage Anthropic prefix caching together with Claude CLI identity headers for long system/tool prefixes.
headerDefaults.codexDescription: Manage OpenAI cache keys together with Codex Responses identity headers while preserving stream/SSE forwarding.

claudeCLIAutoCompact.label: Claude CLI auto compact
claudeCLIAutoCompact.hint: Off by default; passes through Claude CLI native behavior. When on, adds context_management clear_thinking only if the client did not send it, reducing slow long chats and CLI hangs.

claudeCLIReasoningEffort.label: Claude reasoning effort
claudeCLIReasoningEffort.hint: Default "Adaptive": follows the client request — high stays high, low stays low, and if none is sent the model decides on its own; Octopus does not override. Low/Medium/High force that level when the client sent none; Off adds no effort at all.

claudeBetaStripFlags.label: Claude Beta strip flags
claudeBetaStripFlags.hint: When empty, the downstream claude-cli's anthropic-beta is forwarded verbatim (default, zero behaviour change). Set a comma-separated list of beta flags to strip them from the outbound anthropic-beta — an escape hatch for when an upstream (e.g. anyrouter) throws a 520 on a specific flag, while the rest of the genuine shape is preserved.
claudeBetaStripFlags.description: anyrouter escape hatch: comma-separated, empty = off. e.g. prompt-caching-scope-2026-01-05.

codexFastMode.label: Codex fast mode
codexFastMode.hint: Off by default; follows the client request. When on, adds text.verbosity=low and reasoning_effort=low only if the client omitted them — faster output but terser answers.

streamKeepalive.label: Stream keepalive interval
streamKeepalive.hint: Sends a keepalive only during an active streaming request when no output has been written for the configured number of seconds. It does not start another upstream request or consume extra tokens.
streamKeepalive.description: Helps long Claude/MCP tool calls survive reverse proxies and clients that close apparently idle streams.
streamKeepalive.envHint: can still provide the first deployment default.
streamKeepalive.invalid: Keepalive interval must be 0 or a positive integer number of seconds

streamDataTimeout.label: Upstream stream idle timeout
streamDataTimeout.hint: Stops an active streaming request when the upstream provider sends no SSE event for the configured number of seconds. Upstream ping events count as activity.
streamDataTimeout.description: Prevents a stalled upstream stream from being kept alive forever by downstream keepalive writes.
streamDataTimeout.envHint: can still provide the first deployment default.
streamDataTimeout.invalid: Stream idle timeout must be 0 or a positive integer number of seconds

responsesSessionTTL.label: Responses session keep
responsesSessionTTL.hint: Remembers which channel and key own a previous_response_id, reducing broken continuations after restarts or route changes.
responsesSessionTTL.description: Only affects OpenAI Responses continuation routing memory. It does not change normal logs or billing.
responsesSessionTTL.invalid: Responses session keep time must be 0 or a positive integer number of seconds

sessionKeepTimeDefault.label: Global session-keep default
sessionKeepTimeDefault.hint: Fallback sticky window for groups whose own session-keep time is 0, so one client keeps hitting the same channel and key instead of scattering across upstreams and wasting prompt cache.
sessionKeepTimeDefault.description: Only a fallback: a group's own session-keep time still takes precedence. 0 disables the global default and keeps the legacy per-group-only behavior.
sessionKeepTimeDefault.invalid: Global session-keep default must be 0 or a positive integer number of seconds

firstTokenTimeOutDefault.label: Global first-token timeout default
firstTokenTimeOutDefault.hint: Fallback per-channel first-token timeout for groups whose own value is 0; if no first token arrives within this window the request switches to the next candidate channel. Streaming responses only.
firstTokenTimeOutDefault.description: Only a fallback: a group's own first-token timeout still takes precedence. 0 disables the global default and keeps the legacy per-group-only behavior.
firstTokenTimeOutDefault.invalid: Global first-token timeout default must be 0 or a positive integer number of seconds

routeModeOverride.label: Global route-mode override
routeModeOverride.hint: Forces every group to use one routing mode, overriding each group's own choice. Spread = load-balance across same-priority channels; Fill-first = concentrate on the top healthy channel and only sink on failure for a better upstream cache hit rate.
routeModeOverride.description: An override switch: choosing Spread or Fill-first replaces the mode each group picked. Follow group = no override, each group keeps its own configuration.

poolDefaults.title: Model pool global defaults
poolDefaults.hint: Pool-wide routing defaults applied to every group: the mode override forces one mode on all groups; the first-token and session-keep defaults only kick in when a group's own value is 0. A group's own configuration always takes precedence.

userRegistration.label: Allow Direct Registration
userRegistration.hint: When disabled, new users must enter an invite code. When enabled, users can register directly; an invite code still grants its quota or monthly card.

emailVerification.title: Email Verification on Registration
emailVerification.hint: When enabled, public registration requires an email and a 6-digit code sent to it. Configure the SMTP sender below.
emailVerification.passwordKeptPlaceholder: Already set, leave blank to keep current
emailVerification.sslHint: Enable for implicit TLS on port 465. Leave off for STARTTLS (e.g. port 587).
emailVerification.providerHint: Choose how verification codes are sent. HTTP API suits self-hosted services without SMTP (e.g. ClawEmail).

checkIn.title: User Daily Check-in
checkIn.hint: When enabled, signed-in users can claim one balance reward per day from Home. Rewards can be fixed or a random range.

upstreamError.title: Upstream Error Response
upstreamError.hint: Admin logs keep real upstream status and error codes; users can see a public code and friendly message instead.
upstreamError.publicCodePlaceholder: Code shown to users, e.g. service_busy
upstreamError.customPlaceholder: Message shown to users when custom mode is selected

circuitBreaker.title: Circuit Breaker
circuitBreaker.hint: When a channel fails consecutively up to the threshold, circuit breaker trips. Cooldown grows exponentially up to the max cooldown

fingerprintProfile.title: Fingerprint Profiles
fingerprintProfile.description: Prepare multiple independent device fingerprints for different channels, so upstream keys behind different egress IPs present distinct devices instead of sharing one global fingerprint. Leave any field empty to fall back to the global default.
fingerprintProfile.empty: No fingerprint profiles yet. Click New to add one. Channels can still choose "Default (Windows)".
fingerprintProfile.dialogHint: Leave any field empty to fall back to the matching global default; only fill in the fields you want to differ on.
fingerprintProfile.genericUAHint: Unified User-Agent for non Claude/Codex channels (Gemini / Volcengine / plain OpenAI Chat), which emit no UA by default. Leave empty to keep current behaviour.

placeholders.name: A recognizable name, e.g. macOS Claude / Windows Node A
placeholders.seed: Leave empty to auto-generate a random seed on first save
placeholders.genericUA: Empty = keep current behaviour (no UA set)

form.firstTokenTimeOutHint: Unit: seconds, only effective for streaming response, 0 = no limit
form.sessionKeepTimeHint: Unit: seconds, keeps using the same channel within a session, 0 = disabled
form.maxConcurrentHint: Hard cap on concurrent in-flight requests for the whole group (0 = unlimited). The model is already routed here with nowhere to spread, so requests over the cap return 429 to protect the upstream.
form.rpmLimitHint: Hard cap on requests per minute for the whole group (0 = unlimited). Requests over the cap return 429 so the upstream is not maxed out.
form.refreshMatchedHint: Rebuild the selected models from the model pool name or match regex

form.name: Channel Name
form.priorityHint: Lower numbers mean higher priority. Same-priority channels round-robin by default, with cooldown and session affinity.
form.maxConcurrentHint: Hard cap on in-flight requests for this channel (0 = unlimited). At the cap, the channel is deprioritized so bursts spread to other channels, but it stays usable as a last resort.
form.rpmLimitHint: Soft cap on requests per minute for this channel (0 = unlimited). At the cap, the channel is deprioritized so bursts spread to other channels, but it stays usable as a last resort.
form.disableCircuitBreakerHint: When on, this channel behaves like a direct client: every request is forwarded upstream and never short-circuited or benched by the circuit breaker / key cooldown. It hands the "retry to squeeze into upstream capacity" control back to the client. Default off = existing behaviour, zero change.
form.headerPresetHint: CliProxy-style client header presets. They only fill headers, and each row remains editable.
form.cloakModeHint: Simulates the Claude/Codex CLI identity (request headers + body) so risk-controlled relays accept the request. Choose Off for upstreams that don't need it — e.g. domestic models (DeepSeek/GLM). Custom headers still win.
form.channelProxyPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. socks5://user:pass@host:port or http://host:port — this channel only (overrides global proxy)
form.paramOverridePlaceholder: Optional: JSON string to override request params
form.promptOverridePlaceholder: Optional: system prompt applied at this channel layer
form.autoSyncHint: Fetch models on schedule/after save. Newly discovered models stay candidates until an admin enables them.
form.matchRegexPlaceholder: Optional: regex pattern to match request model names
form.cloakProfileHint: Pick a dedicated device fingerprint (managed under Settings - Fingerprint Profiles). "Default (Windows)" reuses the global fingerprint settings without distinction.
